t:
Firstly, and simply: drink water. Drink a bottle - and the heat will recede!

Secondly, you should rest in shelters where jinns are. They are kind, and their magic protects them from the heat.

Thirdly, take a swim. The water - inside or outside - combats the heat well.

Finally, stay in settlements. In camps and cities, the heat is not an issue.

It's all very simple. Got it?
Then go to the desert and do your thing - and if you get hot, grab a bottle and have a drink. Once you're done, come back. The tasks you have to give heroes sometimes... Amazing.

In short, I'm from the future! Don't look so surprised. Time travel is not fantasy, but reality!

The thing is, you are going to have certain problems in the future, and I'm here to fix everything. But I need your help!

For starters, we'll have to travel to the future ourselves and stop a certain someone from making an irredeemable mistake. Listen to me carefully and follow my instructions, and everything will be alright.

We're going to the future. When we get there, I'll help you disguise yourself. Your task is to help me slow down the heroes that are particularly active in that time.

But they really are heroes, not villains. They were just... deceived. So they have to be stopped before they do irreparable damage.

So, do you know anything about the pioneers? Yes, they wear red ties and dream of building a bright Imperial future. It doesn't matter if you are the League or the Empire - you'll have to spend some time as a pioneer!

I knew I could count on you! In addition to saving the world, you will also get decent rewards that will help you in your own time! Now go through the portal. You'll receive further instructions when you get there.
How did you end up here...?
Oh, you...! Let me calibrate it properly, or I'll throw you into a volcano!

I'm going to smack you...!

...Yes, it's done! Go to the stele in the center, place your hand on it, and focus. I'll do the rest.
Wait... You're not the Legendary Orc. You are not even an Orc! And you look pathetic!

The Legendary Orc is testing us!

We started the rebellion just as the prophecy foretold! We overthrew the Xadaganian dogs, gathered everyone, and went to the desert, to the old ship landfill. This is where the new dawn of the Orcs' freedom will come! And we have a proper seer now, the old Shaman Kurgan! He foretold that the Legendary Orc with magical powers will come from this portal... Well, that's you!

What are your orders...?
Hmm... the Legendary Orc wouldn't say something like that... Are you really them...?
Hmm... the Legendary Orc wouldn't say something like that... Are you really them...?
Hmm... the Legendary Orc wouldn't say something like that... Are you really them...?
Legendary Orc, you're with us...! Though you look... Strange. What can you tell us?

It was easy! Of course, we're young Imperial enthusiasts, we never sit idly! A strange substance has recently appeared in the desert. It's called the Ambrosia. I went to study it... but then I was captured by these... oddly dressed fellows.

I'm Alice. A young exobiologist from a biology club. I came to Suslanger like everyone else - to spend a vacation in the famous pioneer camp "Dune", so when the portals went down, I got stuck here like all the others.

Your ears work fine, it seems! Let's see if the rest of you is up to snuff...

Yes, this morning I realized I've been stuck here for too long. I need to leave, and I suspect you're not planning to stick around either.

Now here's the thing. I can break the lock on the cage, it's just a few screws and wires. But the local Orcs are a different matter. They might be poorly organized, but they're strong. In daylight, they'll grab us easily...

Right... I'm sure.

No, we can't do that. These Orcs are not villains, and they do more good than harm... They just lack self-awareness. What kind of hero kills everyone who gets in their way?

...No, I think we can get out of here without any casualties. We must do it this way.

Wait until nightfall, of course!

...But there's another problem. Our cage is guarded by a really diligent Orc - you won't believe it, but he's actually vigilant day and night! He's standing aboard the ship right above me, see?

That's where I'll need your help. You'll distract him while I'll break the lock, and we'll get out... Then we'll improvise!
If I knew, I'd be hopping across the desert right now... Think of something!

Your ghost partner? Yeah, I noticed... You have interesting friends!

I think it might work. But even that trick won't help you during the day... Let's wait for the right time and begin.

I'm a ghost! People will pay attention to me if I want them to. Why do you ask... Ooh!

I get it, you need me to help you escape!

Of course I'll help. We're pals after all. Just point me to where you need me, and I'll pop right up... for seven seconds! In that time, everyone nearby will forget about you... Let's test it on the guard near the cage?
They definitely won't spot us here...

Ah, this? That's just common jinn magic, you'll get properly acquainted with it later.

It's Jinn's Shadow, hides you from anything in the world... Especially from danger.

I borrowed it from a friend in the desert. There are more impressive things out there, trust me!

What can I tell an outsider? Spend some time here, then we'll talk.

I know every local here, and they know me. I'm always happy to help them if there's trouble, and it's the same for them.

I don't care what's happening outside the city - we're too busy maintaining order within our walls... We don't have many guards, and now there's some kind of eruption, then it's the crystals, then thieves... Anyway, less talking, more doing!
The Hero of Sarnaut, you say? We'll see...

I don't even know what to tell you... I'm doing my best trying to stay on top of things! First some merchants arrived, then the incident happened, then a wounded traveler was brought in...

The city is part of the desert, you understand? We have to pay attention to everything around us. We barely have time for ourselves...
Hello! I'm glad to see you!

Well, I... Study. Everything unusual. I used to study jinns before, and now, after the Incident, it's the Ambrosia... There is so much we haven't discovered yet, even among the things we're used to, you know?

I can't say I'm doing really well, but it's a long process - changing the world with your discoveries. Perhaps I'll succeed when I'm old...

But it's particularly hard right now - after I blew up a city district, everyone turned away from me...

It was a pure accident!

I thought Ambrosia explosives were like the Ambrosia, that they would make everything better with their energy! I should have studied the incident carefully...

It turned out an explosion of Ambrosia doesn't affect the living, but everything inorganic gets blown to bits. At least no one got injured, or else they would have kicked me out of the city...
Hmm.. Why didn't I think of this before?

Darn it! Who the hell is this Alice?

I have no idea! I swear!

You might have noticed that she's very much like me. But I'll be damned if I know who she is and where she came from. I suppose, it's just another of Nihaz's tricks. He has a sick 'sensahuma.'

You and I both know one thing: she's clearly lying, trying to buy time. I'm almost completely sure that it was Alice who stole the chronophone. It should be at the pioneer camp.

What choice do we have? All we can do is enter the game. Just like back at the Holy Land where we were looking for Sparks. Well... rather, you were looking for Sparks, and I was rooting for you.

Pioneers accept anyone in their ranks nowadays. It doesn't matter whether you're young or old, belong to the League or the Empire. Such is the time we live in. I don't expect any difficulties for you and Skulnar to blend in. And after you do... there's no mystery that can't be solved by the greatest hero of Sarnaut and the best mystic orc, also known as the chief of the Horde. Research, dig up every tiny detail of Alice's life and history, and find that chronophone!

I've already made an appointment with the superintendent. Get to the Dune right away.
As a superintendent, I know everything about everyone. What exactly do you want to know?
Hm... let me see. She joined shortly after the Incident. Other pioneers stumbled upon her in the city. She told them that she was all alone, no papers, no family. So they invited her to join.

She's a member of the pioneer troop three if I remember correctly. Not the best troop in terms of discipline, but we have what we have. They had an opening, so they took her. You want to look for her next to their lodgings. Even if they're out, you will surely see them at the pioneer lineup.

Why wouldn't I? We allow everyone, who can keep discipline and wishes to become a pioneer. Besides, as far as I was informed, she was left behind in the Old City after the portals were closed. You know, there aren't a lot of places to stay, except the pioneer camp. The city is full of tourists. And the Sanatorium is on another allod. Back in the day they were going to build it next to the pioneer camp but changed their mind. Didn't want to spoil the view. There are no more ships.
Another day, another lineup. Oh, what an endless pioneer cycle...

Hasn't Nina told you? Or did you simply forget? Alright, listen.

First of all, we do a roll call and a headcount during lineups. Say "ME!" every time you hear your name.

Second, we have a problem with the pioneer troop number two. They're always telling each other stupid jokes, making a lot of noise. Stand next to them and block their attempts.

Third, if you let the lineup be disrupted, I'll have to kick you out.

Got it?

Beverages:

 • Xadaganian kefir. 1% fat.

 • Cappuccino.

 • Sweet cranberry compote.

Main course:

 • Goat barbecue, Suslanger style.

 • Bacon crisps with sour cream.

 • Hashbrowns with green peas.

Soups:

 • Red borscht, meat broth.

 • Cheese soup.

 • Sorrel soup, vegetable broth.
We have three troops in the camp. Which one do you want to hear about?

Troop number one is named after Timur Garain, one of the first pioneer of the era before the demonic invasion. Nezeb himself put a triangular scarf on his neck!

There's a curious tradition in the first squad: all members bear the names of legendary pioneer heroes, Suslanger defenders during the demonic invasion. They also wear their weapons and uniforms. As per usual, there are only five outstanding pioneers in this group. Now there's also Katya Rysina. She's very persistent in her studies, work, and sport achievements.

I am the leader of the first troop.

Troop number two is named after Pavel Morozin, another famous pioneer.

It's one of the biggest troops that consists of multiple smaller units. All newcomers join the second troop, including Skulnar and you. Samantha de Delice is a member of the second group. She's a goodwill ambassador, strengthening international cooperation. She represents her aunt Antoinette, who signed a friendship and au-pair agreement with Yasker. Many of our pioneers are visiting Ignis resorts and meeting people of the League.

Anton Kuznetsov is the leader of the second troop.

Troop number three is named after Mishka Kvakin, Timur's sidekick and comrade.

Unfortunately, there are pioneers that don't respect order. Yes, even here, in our beautiful camp! Comrade Dynin decided to gather the likes of them in the third troop to avoid harmful impact on others. Alice is a member of the third troop as well.

Olga Dmitrina is the leader of the third troop.

Oh, you've found it! Let me have it, quick! Oooh, it's intact! Wait. An actress, you say? Now that's not good at all. We don't show our work to the cast before the premier night. Otherwise they'll be unhappy with what we shot. And I don't want to deal with "ooooh, my legs don't look good in this scene, let's get another take on that." I hate it. I hope, she gave you nothing of the sort. Good, good.

Ugh. Alright, at least, now we have the SACK. Now we need to assemble the device. Will you help me?

I came back from a spa treatment... And discovered that almost every crew member uses a nickname. Not their real names. You've been shaking hands, not knowing who they actually are...

Now I know why this job is so hard - I have to work with creative people! That's the effect of the treatment! Life can throw funnier insights at you.

I once saw a news host on manavision show showing life in Sarnaut. Battles, journeys, fates... you might know the announcer. Later on, he worked with the Goblin Banker, announcing new collectible bundles.

He impressed me very much. He was so eager to tell everything that I fell like show everything that was going on in Sarnaut. At that time, the Dream Factory was hiring a cameraman, so I thought, why not?

I'm a cameraman, I deal with the camera, testing how my actors and I can tolerate stress. And when I'm done, I grab my big scissors and begin to cut. And glue. The footage requires a steady hand, the ability to choose, and a creative approach. When I said "cut," I meant I could cut any slacker there is, hehe.

Did I mention stress tolerance? It's really getting on my nerves.
I'm Konstantin Ulitin. Working for the greater good of the Motion Stories. Sometimes I have to go on sedatives, but only a little.
I know what you're talking about but I have no idea where it is. I suspect that the pioneer troop leader might know something. My psychic powers have never let me down.
Of course! I mean, no... Oh. I'm still working on my extrasensory abilities. And someday I'll learn to control them...
I don't know? I don't know?! I know everything around here! I'm a pioneer troop leader, after all. Ask the Superintendent, special objects are his responsibility.
...the SACK object? That's right! It was taken to the first cabin to the left of the camp entrance, where the Dream Factory is.
Great! You're here! I'm beside myself! So nervous! So?

I want to give a speech before the start. You know our pioneers. They love making noise, disturb the peace, and break the order. I get very nervous when I'm interrupted. If I stutter three times, I'll have to start over again. Can you please watch them? Hush them if they make noise. Okay? And then we get to watch the motion history together.

There's a neat pile of clean underwear: white socks, stockings, bows, and other girl stuff.

You go deeper to find a strange object and some green dust.
Contains all sorts of pioneers' things.
There's a neat pile of clean underwear: white socks, stockings, bows, and other girl stuff.

There's a pile of paper scraps, crayons, dried candy.

You keep searching to find a strange object and some green dust.
Contains all sorts of pioneers' things.
There's a pile of paper scraps, crayons, dried candy.

Full of pioneer uniforms. Some of them are brand new. There's also Alice's hiking suit.

You go deeper to find a strange object and some green dust.
Contains all sorts of pioneers' things.
Full of pioneer uniforms. Some of them are brand new. There's also Alice's hiking suit.
She took the small cabin to the right from the entrance. Opposite the Dream Factory cabin.
So you've found me, now what?
A chronophone? What chronophone? I've no idea what you're talking about. I know nothing, I've heard nothing, I've seen nothing. There's nothing to talk about.

Hah! Don't hold your breath! I don't know anything! I just went out for a stroll. So I'm... you know, strolling around, here and there. We're playing hide-and-seek. Ever heard of it? Beat it. Don't be in my way.
What? Who? Speak up! Or look for someone else. My ears are plugged, I can't hear a sound.
I can't see you, I can't hear you. Move it.
Who are you? What brought you here? Beat it. We aren't allowed to talk to strangers.

Still trying, huh? How many answers did you find? How many people did you talk to? Five? Do I get it right? Take my advice, buddy, mind your own business. There's nothing you can do about it. And take your orc with you. All he ever does is eats, eats, eats. There's no place for the likes of him in our ranks.

No one expels you formally. But you aren't one of us, either.
The sun is scorching. You need to hurry.
Why the long face? Did you expect to see someone else here?

My dear young friend, fire of my life, juice of my apple! Your wish is music to my ears, like muezzin's call in the Old Town. Beware! Such power attracts unwanted attention! While you have this blessing on you, you will be attacked by jinns and defenders of the Court of Miracles!

Pit of my peaches, water of my river! You're asking the old jinn the right question! I do not know where the chronophone is. Even I can't know that. But finding the girl named Alice is in my power. I will give you the eyes of the wind, the eyes of the desert! You will see all that you need to see! Follow the footsteps of your friend. The first tracks are right here. She was visiting the old man, too. I wish I could have helped her.
So we have a deal? Don't you try to deceive me. Words have a great meaning where there's a great power behind them.

Huh, another deal! Life truly consists of black and white. Although I'm somewhere in the middle.

It doesn't matter though. I can help you with finding Alice. All I need in exchange is your word. A promise. A partnership agreement, as the Free Traders put it.

Deal?

Alice? Alice, Alice... Alice here, Alice there. Everybody needs an Alice. I wonder why. No one wonders what the poor girl needs.

And I did. And I have the answer. I think I can help. Not for free, of course. This isn't charity.

So our deal is simple. She wanted to get away. Erfar and I wanted the heart of a dragon. You see, thanks to the dragon blood that I got from Nezeb, I was immortal. But his descendants forgot our agreement. Erfar needs the heart to return to the living. Alice promised to get it.

Sounds fair. I completed my part of the deal... unlike her.
So she hasn't believed me, after all. Haha! Even if I had that heart, I would never give it to Erfar.

Alice's story is over.

I'll try something else. There's always hope. Actually, hope is everything we have.
Yes, we need to make things right. I postponed it for as long as I could.

How ignorant can you be? You've had the reply right in front of your eyes the whole time.

I'm Klavdia! Her Reincarnation, to be exact. From the future. The present-me has no idea that I'm about to create another Reincarnation.

I'm not too observant. Even I couldn't tell that me was me.

Still don't believe me?  I remember ordering you to find out who Alice was. I didn't know or realize it back then.

Trust me, a lot is going to happen before I become Alice.

Hah, we're getting closer. I can't change my own future. But I can change YOURS.

Trust me, the future that awaits you... I wouldn't want it for anyone. Anyone, you hear me?

You must not open the Gates! You must not search for my mother! And most importantly, you must not trust my sister!

Yes.

If you disobey me, and I know you will, Sarnaut is doomed. Not the Darkness, but Life itself will become its tombstone. Can I change what's happened to me?

Who am I? Must I exist in your timeline? I'm just an anomaly, neither dead nor alive, stuck between existence and non-existence. By changing the past, I'm deleting myself. I don't have the divine immortality any longer. Any death would be final. I've torn the thread of my fate.

Only one issue remains.
Do you believe me or not?

That's too bad!

But you'll have to learn that I was right. It's time to say goodbye now.

Fine.

Try to convince me from your time that I'm telling the truth. It's time to say goodbye now.
You've got the right to hear the answers.

Look around. This is the Court of Miracles.

Each allod has one. Have you ever seen a beggar? All of them are working for me. They're physically healthy, only pretending to be sick and injured. As they return to their shelters, their injuries disappear by magic. Hence the Court of Miracles.

Although mine is truly mind-blowing.

As to the Brotherhood... I've always needed someone to guard the ruins and Nezeb's treasures in the sands. Exiles, outcasts, and rebels are a perfect fit. They've been serving me for centuries, thinking that they're rebelling against authorities.

I give him information and support in exchange for the immortality. You already know about the Great Mages' Ambassadors. Those who aren't mages but who had dragon blood. You're one of them, but as you know, the power is limited. It has to be refilled. That's why I need dragon blood.

Alas, my source has disappeared together with Nezeb. Yasker wouldn't deal with me. Biiiig mistake. He could have done so much more with me. He's drowning in a sea of petty things he's unable to figure out.

Only the return of Nezeb can save the Empire.

That's right. Sarn's trap has shut. But our Emperor is still in Sarnaut. I know that you saved his Spark from Tep's Pyramid. Then you met him on Eclipse. Nezeb dwells in the deep layers of the Astral.

Amazed by my knowledge? Now you see that you'd better respect our agreement. I know many things. I have eyes and ears everywhere.

You will help me bring it back. How? I don't know. Yet.

A couple of things.

My spies noticed strange activity under the surface of this Allod. These caves belonged to Wormfaces. Their network is still working. Obviously, they're gathering power. The Star Gates in the Dead City are a valuable prize.

Now you have the Gates of your own. They're wanted by all those who want to leave Sarnaut. Watch out, though. The enemy won't give you margin for error if you use them.
Of course, they have. Every valuable thing eventually lands in the hands of the Brotherhood. Here. Make sure you don't lose it again! How did you even pull it off?

She and Fomkin just can't stop getting in and out!

To the town, to the mountains, to the lake! All I do is register their leaves and returns!

Please, talk to her.

You should talk to Ulyana Radziecka. She's Alice's roommate.

I haven't been following her. Sorry.
Trust between friends is important. If you really trust Alice, you should know that we all must be extremely careful.
Don't worry, kylys. I'll ask her.

Her? No, never. Not even once.

But she's been hanging out with Phima Korolkin. He's the one that sends mail. To his mom, to his granny. Picks up parcels all the time. For all I know, he could be sending her letters as well.

When I first met Alice, she was wearing pajamas... or a robe. I asked her if she was a pioneer. She said yes. I asked what happened to her uniform, and she told me she'd lost it.

So I picked up another uniform for her. They didn't find a pioneer set, so I took a school uniform. It looked good on her anyway.

But then I learned that Alice always picks up new uniforms! And never wears them! She just hands them over to her friends behind trash cans at the cafeteria.

Now I'm not sure that I did the right thing.

If you go along with my plan, we'll know what's what.

For starters, it'd be nice to talk to everyone who had anything to do with her enrollment. Ask them what they know about her and how they met her.

You've already talked with Dynin and Nina. You can reach out to the following comrades:

First, Katya Rysina. She isn't in her troop, but Katya is keeping notes who left the camp and when. If Alice goes out, we'll know how often.

Second, it's Mister Postman Igor Pechkin. If Alice has been sending letters, he should know.

Third, it's Esenia Linen. She distributes uniforms. She can tell you who took one for Alice.

Fourth, it's Yana Cutlet. She hangs out by the cafeteria. She should know if Alice eats often.

Fifth, it's Maya Lamb. I know that Alice helped her. Find out what it was.

Sixth, our nurse, Viola de Ardeur. She gives everyone medical exams and takes everyone's weight. She should know if there's something wrong with Alice.

Seventh, it's Zina from the first troop. I'm sure she knows something! Aoidois have a nose for weird stuff.

Eighth, it's Sergey Russule. He's the mana tech club leader. The most suspicious thing is that Alice has joined the club! Besides, I know Sergey. He used to be a slacker and a buzzkill, and now he really got it together. It's strange.

Oh no, don't give me this look. Yes, it requires some running around! Do you want to know who Alice is or not?

Excellent! I'll tell Alice that you want to join the brotherhood of the thingamajig keepers!

We'll beat the pirates together!

We only need to find the other pirate.

I'm sure you are.

It would be great to know what Alice likes. If she has a secret, it might also be her main interest. We need to find out somehow... But how? Slavyana might know. She should know. I'll just go and ask her about Alice's thing. I saw them talking about it once but I only had music in my head and didn't care to listen! I should figure out what she's hiding and make her a good gift.

…

Are you even listening?

She told me about it. She told me about that one time when you saved her from the lizards. However, when you were running away from orcs, it was her who saved you, not the other way round. But oh well.

I've known Alice for a while. If you need to talk, you should talk to her directly.

Hah! It's you who arrived with that fat orc, right? The pioneer leader Nina accepted you in the ranks! I don't think that a militia officer needs to be accepted. You're probably doing your own dark stuff here.
A friend, you say? Can you prove it? Literally anyone can come here and claim to be Alice's friend.

Oh really? Then our talk doesn't matter either. Quit sniffing around, you! Do something useful. Weed the flower beds or sweep the pavement. It's better than hanging around, harassing people with meaningless stuff.
The library is closed for renovations. I don't lend books at the moment.

The redhead witch?

She should be in prison! Or in a loony bin!
Just take a good look! Does she look like a real pioneer to you? She's an impostor!

Yes! I know for a fact that Alice isn't a pioneer.

I've been a librarian since my family had to quit the League a while ago. But never mind that!

I have my own black list of book thieves. I even blacklist friends of those who delayed a book, because who lives with cripples learns to limp. So pretty much every pioneer is in my list.

I know exactly who was going to Suslanger for this season. Alice wasn't one of them.

I even looked up passenger lists at the port ticket office. No Alice there.
What is it? Go on, tell me.

I see. So we have a group of suspects. We will have to do some running around.

You ought to visit other comrades.

First, it's Phima Korolkin and Kolya Fomkin. They're obviously her sidekicks.

Second, her buddies Maas-Yulee, Lena Tihonova, Sarang Mika, and Ulyana Radziecka. I also think that Samantha might know something. Ask her.

Third, it's Russule. He says he's got a secret, hah. But I know what the matter is! Katya has seen him in town recently. I saw him at the camp at the same time! What a mystery. Two Russules! One of them might be an impostor. Find Russule in town and find out which one is real.

I knew it! I knew it!

This Alice isn't a pioneer! Go to Dynin right now! Demand that he kick her out!

I knew it! It's all fraud.
Alice? What would you like to know?

Alice?

Hmmm... you know, you're right. She's a pretender!

Before she came along, I had been the best student! Now she's the straight A-student. She knows history better than me, she knows astral geography, and even PE is her forte! No normal human is capable of it!

No! Alice is hundred percent honest! I trust her!

I have absolutely no reason to trust you!

Really? Really-really?

If it's the truth, I can tell you, I guess. Alice wanted me to hide something. I don't know what it is, but it's very valuable.

I have no idea where it is now. Only Alice knows that, I guess.

No! She's incapable of using people.

She's willing to help everyone! And she has, many times! She's here to save us all. I don't really understand, from what... But it doesn't matter. We all trust Alice.
She should... I tried to ask her, but she said it was a big secret not for everyone.
Not at all. And I don't care about them. Why are you asking?
I have. But to tell you the truth, I regret it.
Let me see... She's got several packs already! I don't know how but she manages to tear it! Like, all the time! I already gave her the whole summer stock.

I might be wrong but it could be Lena Tihonova.

That's right! We were out of standard pioneer uniform, and I had to give her the school pack.

That was rude. You don't understand. I was in a coffin for so many years, it's so boring... I didn't feel a thing, but just think of all the things that I missed. Other races didn't waste time, they came up with so many fascinating things! Let's take elves, for example. A lot of my fellow citizens hate elves, but I like them. Not as grim, very fun and always inventing something. They didn't really like us before. It's understandable. When you dig up from the grave, you don't look very pleasant. But now they don't mind us. Especially since we're covering our imperfections. It's not that difficult to be friends with elves. I'm so happy there's no more war! I never wanted it, in the first place. War and music don't have anything in common. Just picture me with a guitar, dashing forward to attack an enemy. It's ridiculous. It's a nightmare.

…

Are you even listening?

Alice? Hiding? Never heard of it. Ooh! I know! She wants to surprise me and is hiding a gift! What do you think this is? I would love a new mana guitar. Should I tell her? Or not? If she's prepared something... it might ruin it. But I really really really want a good mana guitar. The old one's all shabby. If Alice knew, she would totally get me a new one! She's so kind and generous. Everyone brings her these useless green crystals, and she exchanges them for really great gifts! I've seen it with my own eyes. Perhaps, we should get her something too. I must decide what. She's so versatile, it's a rough choice. Music? Sports? Science? I think I should ask her very carefully...

…

Are you even listening?

Alice? Is that the one in the school uniform? The redhead?

She talks all the time! One person or another!

Nah, I wouldn't say so. She's a talker alright. A real life of the party.

They've talked with Sarang Mika just recently. She is unlike other undead. She really likes to talk.
Alice steals chops to feed the orc announcer, but shh... it's for your ears only!

What an interesting story!

I've been thinking why Russule suddenly became such outstanding pioneer!

Well, no trouble at all. We'll just register the mechanoid as his twin brother. We just need to come up with a name. Aoidoi mentioned a very curious one... how was it? Oh, right. Electron! Let's name him Electron.

As to Alex, I was expecting him to ask me out on a date. All the while he was going through all pins and gears in devices!

Oh, my young friend, the joy of my heart!

They are mostly comprised of Xadaganian units, and their main goal is to protect the imperial allods. Meaning defense. Except every allod the Empire has set foot on is already ours, so we have to defend everything.

Who can tell anymore? It's like everyone has lost their mind. First there were rumors of this Orc that studied magic... And no one really cared, though the Shaman started yelling that we should leave the Empire.

Then there was this conflict on Izune. They sent armies without us Orcs there. Told us to sit quietly for now. Then Fury showed up, Crazystorm's daughter. She incited us to a rebellion, and one by one, the Orcs went to the Landfill. There's no one left here now.

Are you mocking me?

You are looking at the last Orc in this cursed city. Who do you think I am? I'm a loser. All my pals are at the Landfill. I'm the only one left. Because I swore an oath. Because I don't believe this crap about the Orcs who will rule the world.

I tried to argue with them. Punched a few faces. Cursed. Pleaded! But no, no one listened to me. They have gone crazy, all of them. "Freedom for Orcs", pshaw! As though we're all in chains slaving away at some mine. What do they want? We have food, women. We fight on occasion. That's all they want!

It's too bad I didn't die sooner.

I was exiled for the boldness of my questions and theories. Just imagine that: as soon as I touched a raw nerve, a scandal erupted...

I have been to many places, like you, and even somewhere you wouldn't dare think about. After my exile, I broke all the laws - from trivial to the law of gravity.

I knew your enemy, Nihaz... But we had a different kind of relationship.

You don't need to know more.
A strange intelligent creature with orange eyes is peering at you attentively and with interest... As if by itself, a question pops up in your head.

An exile from the House de Desirae, forgotten by the general public.  They called me many things in my life - strange, crazy, eccentric... Only those who understood me saw me differently: a researcher, a threat to the world!

I am one of those who believe that everything is possible - you just need to muster up enough strength and willpower!

You have no idea how narrow your view is: you're not even trying to comprehend the structure of the world!

Tell me, when was the last time the Hero of Sarnaut tried to understand the full picture? You are immortal, but you don't seem to be taking advantage of it, missing all these opportunities! After all, you can carry out the most dangerous experiments without a risk to your life.

And then what? Just cut off the heads in battle. One after another.

No other options?

You are so... Everyone is so narrow-minded, never trying to think outside the square. Stereotypes - that's their word! But they always look and sound so pompous...!

I want to learn, to create!
But you're a person. You're brave and strong, you can be the master of your destiny.
Childhood will be over eventually, it doesn't last forever.
The most important question for me right now is this: what does it mean to be a true person? I'm looking for an answer. So far unsuccessfully.
I would like to know an answer to this myself...
I took the first place in running, mathematics, and chess competitions. But I'm afraid I still haven't found an answer to the question that bothers me.
Hi, I'm Sergey from the third pioneer group. It's nice to meet you!
Priestess of the Church of Light She's the doctor and a nurse here.

I've had enough of them! We welcomed them with open arms, granted them rights, and what did they do? Did they thank us? No!

I can't stand these Orcs. They take our jobs. If there's a hard work that pays well, they always hire the Orcs. They even got into the army. What about our common Xadaganian guys?

The crime rate has also increased. We used to have order in our cities... and now? If there's an Orc district, it's best not to set foot in there at night. And during the day, too! And goblins? Where the Orcs are, goblins usually follow. Nothing like this ever happened under Nezeb's rule! Nezeb would have put them in their place!
I'm just a plant worker. Got a ticket to the local sanatorium. My vacation is over now, but I'm still here. I'm stuck here, and now there are Orcs everywhere! I hate them!

What do you think I'm doing here? Looking after the local library. It's a nightmare if you ask me. Every book must be returned on time, let alone returned in a proper condition!

Do you think anyone at this camp follows these simple rules? At all? No!

So I had to close down the library.

Are you blind? Can't you see I'm a librarian?

When I first got to this beautiful camp, I thought there's be order. The League lacks order! We need to learn from the Empire. It was a disappointment. As messy as Irene's brothel!

I came to this camp to start friendship with imperial comrades. It all started with my letter to the Great Mage Yasker... after which he and Antoinette, the head of our House, decided to go with an exchange. Pioneers from the Empire were supposed to visit League allods, and we, different races of the League, were supposed to visit this amazing Duna pioneer camp!

I am Samantha de Delice, the official elven and League ambassador in this pioneer camp! I have an honorable mission to reconcile the League and the Empire. The sole fact that I'm here is a testament to my big success.

This and that. Many things. We swim, we hike, we prank! Comrade Dynin, the superintendent, is so funny when he gets angry for what we've done! He can't actually kick anyone out. You see, this allod is closed!

Goblinball and other sports are my favorite. Some day, I'm gonna win all golden medals at the Dionic Games.

I'm Ulyana Radziecka. Gibberling were very happy to visit this camp too!

It's so fun and there are so many people! Of course, it gets a little boring over time but we have so many friends! Together we invent mischief, so it's alright.

Hello! I'm a simple merchant from Nezebgrad. I sell the produce of our cooperative, buy local goods and sell them in Nezebgrad. I hear there's some sort of Ambrosia... must be valuable! I'll need to stock up. So I'm sorry, but I only accept Ambrosia for the time being!
The best goods from our stores in Nezebgrad! They are really hard to find!
What do you know? It's a rarity. The paper has a headline from Nezeb's time! A true rarity!

Hi!

I'm responsible for keeping all pioneers' clothes tidy. I wash, dry, and iron. I can also give you a uniform.
Of course. It isn't given out for free, though.
Hello! I'm a cafeteria janitor. Sadly, food can be left over. And then Gerasim comes to rescue.
Gerasim is a fine example of the imperial teaching system success! Even an ogre can be a normal member of society! Would you like to have a friend like him?

Good afternoon, comrade!

I'm in charge of the zoo.
Of course. We have a cute jerboa, who can play a horn.
Oh, a new recruit! I could always use an extra pair of hands...

To stop your predecessors from destroying our world... But neither me nor my recruits can do it directly. So good old sabotage and false identities come into play... You'll understand when you get your tasks. Jump into the portal, we'll talk on the other side.

My crowning accomplishment! Cutting the fabric of space-time in a way that creates neat little holes is a difficult task, considering the number of ruptures you and the likes of you have left behind. I patched up our poor world a little...

This rift leads to Suslanger in the future. Where I need help.
Because the heroes of the present have all been deceived, and I'm unable to reverse it. But it's not too late for you!

In any story, there is a key moment when the future becomes set in stone. Alas, the choices we made and will make, our decisions, actions and inaction - all that shapes the future that leads to the inevitable outcome.

I need heroes that have yet to make certain decisions. Those who completed the journey to Sogot, learned the prophecies about the doom of the world, and made preparations to follow the Infinity - they are not the people I need.

I do not appear in their space-time frame.

In the future, Suslanger will be selected for one very interesting scientific experiment. It would be an attempt to leave this place. But it will have certain consequences that we'd really like to avoid.

The only thing you need to know now is that a strange energy came through the Gates that were constructed there. It awakened the jinns who had been dormant for a very long time. This energy has a physical form - the Ambrosia. And it's the Ambrosia and the fire jinns, Ifrits, that we'll be dealing with.

You see, in this future the League and the Empire agreed on a truce and started working together, although I understand if you find that hard to believe. People from the League also started joining the pioneers. So anyone can become a pioneer, and no one will suspect them. It's a perfect disguise for us!

To save the world - isn't it a noble cause?

Fine, I know you, heroes. You'll be rewarded, of course. You will become stronger, more experienced, wealthier. You will lead your guild to glory... Suslanger is a prosperous place - it's where Nezeb hid his treasures. And they can become yours! So, ready to go after the treasures?

I just need to distract the heroes from the future for a while to slow them down.
